question: Select the correct statement regarding the properties of diagonals of a rhombus.

options.text: The diagonals of a rhombus are equal, intersect at right angles and bisect each other
The diagonals of a rhombus are not equal, intersect at right angles and bisect each other.
The diagonals of a rhombus are equal, intersect at right angles and do not bisect each other
The diagonals of a rhombus are equal, do not intersect at right angles and bisect each other

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A **Rhombus** is a special **Parallelogram** where all four sides are equal.

Property 1: Diagonals of any parallelogram **bisect** each other.

Property 2: Diagonals of a rhombus are **perpendicular** (intersect at 90°).

Property 3: Geometrically, diagonals are **unequal** in length (unless it is a square).

Conclusion: Diagonals are **not equal**, **bisect** each other, and meet at **right angles**.

∴ The correct answer is The diagonals of a rhombus are not
